description: A will contest: asking the will's drafter for their file is a Larke v Nugus request to them
query: Hollis & Partners drew Graham's 2019 will. Can we ask them for their file on how it was prepared and signed?
answer: Yes. Hollis & Partners Lawyers, who prepared the will dated 11 June 2019, are on the matter. A request to the drafter for their file and an account of how the will was prepared and signed is usually the first step in a will dispute. I can't send it, but Materia can offer to start that letter for you to check.
